meta.name: add-clidash
meta.description: Add clidash — a zero-dependency, read-only web dashboard that derives its tabs and tables at runtime from any CLI that lists resources as JSON. Ships pre-wired for NanoClaw's ncl CLI (agent groups, sessions, channels, users, roles), plus message-activity charts, a log tail, and a read-only file viewer for group skills/CLAUDE.md/profiles.

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude copies a read-only web dashboard into tools/clidash and writes its config; you open 127.0.0.1:4690 and get one tab per CLI resource, plus Agents overview, activity charts, logs and a file viewer.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add clidash, or to give a JSON-listing CLI like ncl a read-only web dashboard. It binds 127.0.0.1 by default and needs Node 22.5+.

say_en.text: Install clidash into tools/clidash and run it
say_en.note: Copies files, creates the config, serves 127.0.0.1:4690

Set BIND to my tailnet IP so I can reach it elsewhere
